rev.t: Comparing this visit with an earlier one, what stood out was how the decor made the surroundings feel welcoming, and this meant everyone could relax comfortably.

Cuppa Café in Bangalore is a great spot for anyone who loves good food and a calm place to work. The food is consistently tasty and comforting. The work setup is one of the best with a peaceful atmosphere that makes it easy to focus and get things done. A simple place that gets everything right.
